data.name: Hotel Bellavista
data.address: Vicente Pérez Rosales 60, 5551023 Puerto Varas, Los Lagos, Chile
data.description:
Off the Ruta 225-CH highway, this down-to-earth hotel overlooks Lake Llanquihue and the Osorno volcano. It's a 4-minute walk from the nearest bus stop and a 10-minute walk from Centro Cultural Estación Mapocho.
Warm rooms have wood paneling, and feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screens, and lake and volcano views. Some have balconies, while elegant suites add panoramic lake views and living/dining areas. A duplex suite sleeps 6 people.
Freebies include parking, and a continental breakfast buffet served in a rustic-chic regional restaurant. There's also an indoor pool and a sauna, plus a cozy bar with a fireplace. Event spaces are available.
